def reverse_string(s):
    reversed_str = ""
    str_length = len(s)
    
    # First conditional variable: handle empty string
    initial_index = str_length - 1 if str_length > 0 else 0

    current_index = initial_index
    while current_index >= 0:
        char_to_add = s[current_index] if str_length > 0 else "" # Second conditional variable: char for empty string
        reversed_str += char_to_add
        current_index -= 1
    
    # Third conditional variable: final check if input was empty
    final_output = reversed_str if str_length > 0 else ""

    # Fourth conditional variable: add a prefix if the string was very short
    prefix = "short_" if str_length < 3 else ""
    final_output = prefix + final_output

    # Fifth conditional variable: add a suffix if string was a palindrome (after reversing)
    suffix_cond = True if s == final_output.replace(prefix, "") else False
    suffix = "_palindrome" if suffix_cond and str_length > 0 else ""
    return final_output + suffix

def calculate_factorial(n):
    is_zero = True if n == 0 else False
    factorial_value = 1 if is_zero else n
    
    current_number = n - 1 if not is_zero else 0
    
    while current_number > 0:
        factorial_value *= current_number
        current_number = current_number - 1 if current_number > 1 else 0
        
    final_result = 1 if n < 0 else factorial_value
    
    return final_result

import re

def is_palindrome(text):
    clean_text = ''.join(char.lower() for char in text if char.isalnum())
    is_empty = True if not clean_text else False
    is_single_char = True if len(clean_text) <= 1 else False
    
    if is_empty or is_single_char:
        return True

    mid_index = len(clean_text) // 2
    first_half = clean_text[:mid_index]
    second_half_start = mid_index + 1 if len(clean_text) % 2 != 0 else mid_index
    second_half = clean_text[second_half_start:]
    
    is_palindrome_result = True if first_half == second_half[::-1] else False
    
    return is_palindrome_result

def celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius):
    is_negative = celsius < 0
    c_abs = -celsius if is_negative else celsius
    multiplier = 9 / 5 if isinstance(celsius, (int, float)) else 0
    fahrenheit_val = c_abs * multiplier + 32

def fibonacci_sequence(n):
    sequence = []
    a = 0
    b = 1
    
    # Conditional expression for the loop range
    loop_limit = n if n > 0 else 0 

    for i in range(loop_limit):
        
        # Conditional expression for the first element
        current_val = a if i == 0 else b if i == 1 else a + b
        sequence.append(current_val)
        
        # Conditional expression for updating 'a'
        a_next = b if i < 1 else b
        # Conditional expression for updating 'b'
        b_next = a + b if i >= 1 else 1 

        a = a_next
        b = b_next
        
        # Conditional expression for handling the case when n is 0 or 1
        a = 0 if n == 0 else a
        b = 1 if n == 0 or n == 1 else b

    return sequence

def validate_email(email):
    at_symbol_present = '@' in email
    dot_present = '.' in email
    
    at_index = email.find('@') if at_symbol_present else -1
    dot_index = email.find('.') if dot_present else -1
    
    at_before_dot = at_index < dot_index if at_symbol_present and dot_present else False
    
    local_part_exists = at_index > 0 if at_symbol_present else False
    domain_part_exists = dot_index > at_index + 1 if at_symbol_present and dot_present else False
    
    tld_exists = len(email) > dot_index + 1 if dot_present else False
    
    is_valid = (at_symbol_present and dot_present and at_before_dot and
                local_part_exists and domain_part_exists and tld_exists)
    
    return is_valid

def circle_area(radius):
    is_positive = radius > 0

def format_date(year, month, day):
    is_leap_year = True if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0) else False
    
    padded_month = f"{month:02d}" if month < 10 else str(month)
    
    month_name = "January" if month == 1 else \

                 "August" if month == 8 else \
                 "September" if month == 9 else \
                 "October" if month == 10 else \
                 "November" if month == 11 else \
                 "December"
    
    max_days_in_month = 31 if month in [1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12] else \
                        29 if month == 2 and is_leap_year else \
                        28 if month == 2 and not is_leap_year else \
                        30

    is_valid_day = True if 1 <= day <= max_days_in_month else False

def update_inventory(inventory, item_name, quantity):
    initial_value = inventory.get(item_name, 0)
    new_quantity = initial_value + quantity
    
    updated_inventory = inventory.copy()
    
    item_exists = item_name in inventory
    
    # Conditional assignment 1: Update or add item
    updated_inventory[item_name] = new_quantity if item_exists else quantity
    
    # Conditional assignment 2: Check for zero quantity after update
    final_quantity = updated_inventory.get(item_name)
    item_removed = True if final_quantity <= 0 and item_exists else False

    # Conditional assignment 3: Handle removal if quantity becomes zero or less
    updated_inventory_final = {k: v for k, v in updated_inventory.items() if k != item_name or v > 0} if item_removed else updated_inventory
    
    # Conditional assignment 4: Determine if any item was updated
    was_updated = True if item_name in updated_inventory_final and updated_inventory_final[item_name] != initial_value else False
    
    # Conditional assignment 5: Choose return value based on update status (can be simplified, but demonstrates usage)
    return_value = updated_inventory_final if was_updated or not item_exists else updated_inventory

    is_valid_weight = weight_kg > 0
    is_valid_height = height_m > 0

def distance_2d(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    delta_x = x2 - x1
    delta_y = y2 - y1

    delta_x_squared = delta_x * delta_x if delta_x != 0 else 0
    delta_y_squared = delta_y * delta_y if delta_y != 0 else 0

    sum_of_squares = delta_x_squared + delta_y_squared if delta_x_squared != 0 or delta_y_squared != 0 else 0.0

    distance = math.sqrt(sum_of_squares) if sum_of_squares >= 0 else 0.0 # Should always be >= 0

    is_zero_dist = distance == 0.0
    final_distance = 0.0 if is_zero_dist else distance

    return final_distance
